lines.en: I am sturdier than the other worms.
My shell has an extra layer.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方酸味更重。
lines.en: My trail smells sharper.

lines.zh: 我从沙里探出半截厚壳。
lines.en: I push half my thick shell out of the sand.
Little spines hang on my feelers.
My acid smokes on the sand.
I move faster than my kin.

lines.zh: 酸液滴在沙上，冒起白烟。
lines.en: The acid drips onto sand and raises white smoke.
I stop and tighten my shell.
My feelers sweep the sand.
I drag my tail buried in the sand.
My furrow through the sand is deep.
I move more than my kin.
I keep to the shaded side of the dune.
My shell grates on gravel.
I lie on the sand, motionless.
My shell heats in the sun.
I slowly open my feelers.
I listen beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 我的酸在壳口凝成小珠。
lines.en: My acid beads at the shell's opening.
There is an old scar on my shell.
I wait for my shell to harden more.
I retract my feelers one by one.
Sand slowly covers my tail.
I am growing the next layer.
You are standing on my sand.
I raise my head, shell toward you.
Your sole is already damp.
Don't reach into the sand.
My feelers are hunting your feet.
I push forward slowly.
Which way did you come from?
This sand is mine.
I shrink into the sand.
A white line opens on my thick shell.
The acid drips more slowly.

lines.zh: 我把壳缩到石头背风面。
lines.en: I tuck my shell behind the stone.
I coil tight.
One spined feeler broke.
I make a muffled sound.
Shell cracked; I can still push.

lines.zh: 我把软边全部压进沙里。
lines.en: I press every soft edge into the sand.
I settle my shell and build acid again.
The smell of iron is strong.
I can eat what you hold.
Put it down and back off.
My shell needs exactly this.
Come closer; I won't bite.
I raise my head and wait.
If your hand shakes, the acid will splash.
That's a decent size.
I'm so hungry my feelers droop.
Three steps back; my acid reaches.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳，我顶了你一下。
lines.en: You stepped on my shell; I bumped you.
This shell of mine outweighs you.
My acid splashed your trouser leg.
Don't grind my shell underfoot.
I push to the edge of your shoe.
I got shoved onto my side.

lines.zh: 我的触须打到你的脚踝。
lines.en: My feelers hit your ankle.
You step back; I shift slowly.
I settle my thick shell face-on.
We churn the sand.
I am the strongest in this brood.
My shell has just hardened.
Don't touch my soft rim.
I have coiled; stay back.
My kind grows slowly.
Go find the little ones.
I drag my shell back into the sand.
My acid would burn you.
Under the sand is my place.
I have burrowed in.
I curl a feeler around it.
Iron. Good.
Too heavy to drag.
I clamp down on it.
It tastes decent.

lines.zh: 这块铁我按进沙里藏好。
lines.en: I press this iron into the sand to hide it.

lines.zh: 这块太小，塞不满我的壳。
lines.en: Too small — it will not fill my shell.
I roll it under my shell.
This is too hard for my teeth.

lines.zh: 你在我的沙上踩了太多脚。
lines.en: You've left too many prints on my sand.
All my feelers are up.
I raise my body.
The sand by your feet is bubbling.
I am faster than my kin.
Don't retreat to the stones.
My acid has seeped down.
I count the sand you cave in.
This sand flat is my nest.
I push up out of the sand.
Close enough.

lines.zh: 我把带刺的触须立起来。
lines.en: I raise my spined feelers.
I keep my thick shell low to the sand.
My acid blackens the sand.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就快一寸。
lines.en: Each step you back, I gain an inch.
I stretch my feelers out full.
It's bubbling under the sand.

lines.zh: 厚壳贴着沙，我绕到你侧后。
lines.en: Thick shell low on the sand, I circle behind you.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方都是我的路。
lines.en: Everywhere you step becomes my path.
I'm slower, but you must rest.
Your soles are softening.
One step closer and the acid lands.
I have raised my shell.
The sand has blackened.

lines.zh: 我的酸在皮上烧出白烟。
lines.en: My acid smokes on your skin.
I ram you with my thick shell.

lines.zh: 厚壳这一撞比看上去实。
lines.en: The thick shell hits harder than it looks.
I bite your heel.
Once coiled, I don't loosen.

lines.zh: 带刺的触须绕住你的手指。
lines.en: Spined feelers coil your fingers.
You caught a burn.
I let go and circle behind you.
I come up through the sand under you.
The sand splits; my shell shows first.
This is my nest.
My shell is thicker than my kin's.
My acid lingers in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把肥厚的身子摊在沙上。
lines.en: I spread my thick body on the sand.
I hear wind far off.
I picked the driest stretch of sand.
My feelers come out first.
I raise my head and look around.
There are no other worms here.
I begin patrolling my sand.
I wait for my shell to harden.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的厚壳，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire bakes my thick shell and I curl tight.
I fell and chipped my shell.

lines.zh: 水把酸冲走，我的壳发软。
lines.en: Water washes my acid away and my shell softens.

lines.zh: 酸液从我的甲壳缝里渗。
lines.en: Acid seeps from my shell seams.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的厚壳。
lines.en: Something pierced my thick shell.
Spell-light congeals my acid.
Without iron my shell won't grow.

lines.zh: 雷打过我的壳，我半天没动。
lines.en: Lightning hit my shell; I lay still a long while.
The sand is gone and I keep falling.
